_comment: Starter MCP host configuration. Save as .mcp.json at the repo root (Claude Code), .cursor/mcp.json, or .vscode/mcp.json. Credentials are env-var references; literal secrets never appear in this file. IMPORTANT: every key below beginning with an underscore, plus audit and alertOn, is IGNORED BY EVERY HOST. They document the policy for humans and reviewers; they enforce nothing. Confirmation before a high-risk call is host behaviour informed by a tool annotation (readOnlyHint / destructiveHint / idempotentHint / openWorldHint), and the only place a Tier 4 action can actually be refused is inside the server itself. There is no requiresConfirmation field in MCP.

repo-search._description: Read-only repository search and file reads

_audit.destination: <log destination, e.g. stdout-json or specific service>

prod-db-read._description: Read-only access to production database (SELECT only, no PII columns)

alertOn: queries matching LIKE patterns on email/phone columns

prod-deploy._description: Deploy to production. Every invocation requires human approval.
prod-deploy._approval: Enforced inside the server: every invocation blocks on human approval. Not enforced by this file.
